games.name: Modern Gun Strike Offline FPS
games.description: Modern Gun Strike is the free shooting game that took everything players hated about mobile FPS games — clunky controls, pay-to-win BS, bad hit detection — and deleted it. What's left is pure, heart-pounding combat that hits different every single match.

games.name: Gun Game 3D - FPS Shooter
games.description: Gun Game 3D - FPS Shooter is an action-packed first-person shooter where every elimination upgrades your weapon. Battle through intense combat missions, unlock powerful guns, and test your shooting skills against challenging enemies. Experience smooth controls, realistic 3D environments, and fast-paced FPS gameplay as you fight to become the ultimate gun master.
